Every slash command this bot registers, for developers: where it is defined, what it
takes, who may run it, and what it reads and writes. Members' and staff's guides to the
same commands are in the FZD docs.

## In-game schedule

### `/showevents`

List the upcoming in-game events, in your local time.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`py/pengbot99/bot.py:243`](../py/pengbot99/bot.py#L243) |
| Usage | `/showevents [utc_time]` |
| Checks in code | none |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Everyone |
| Where | #ask-pengbot. Admin and Circuit Crew can also use it in the staff channels they can see, such as #playground, #bot-playground and #host-hub. |
| Reads and writes | The active profile's slot 2 schedule (`controller.slot2mgr.list_events`). |
| Side effects | Replies in the channel, for everyone to see. |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Choices as you type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `utc_time` | text | no |  |  | The UTC time from which to display events as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM |

### `/when`

List the next times an event type runs, in your local time.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`py/pengbot99/bot.py:316`](../py/pengbot99/bot.py#L316) |
| Usage | `/when <event_type> [count]` |
| Checks in code | none |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Everyone |
| Where | #ask-pengbot. Admin and Circuit Crew can also use it in the staff channels they can see, such as #playground, #bot-playground and #host-hub. |
| Reads and writes | The active profile's slot 2 schedule; slot 1 for Glitch 99; the slot 2 manager's Secret League config for Secret League. |
| Side effects | Replies in the channel, for everyone to see. |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Choices as you type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `event_type` | text | yes |  | yes | The kind of event, such as King League, Mini-Prix, Glitch 99, Team Battle or Secret League. |
| `count` | number | no | 5 |  | How many events to display - must be from 1 to 12 (default 5) |

### `/utc_when`

Like `/when`, but counting from a UTC time you give.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`py/pengbot99/bot.py:333`](../py/pengbot99/bot.py#L333) |
| Usage | `/utc_when <event_type> <from_time> [count]` |
| Checks in code | none |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Everyone |
| Where | #ask-pengbot. Admin and Circuit Crew can also use it in the staff channels they can see, such as #playground, #bot-playground and #host-hub. |
| Reads and writes | As `/when`. |
| Side effects | Replies in the channel, for everyone to see. |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Choices as you type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `event_type` | text | yes |  | yes | The kind of event, such as King League, Mini-Prix, Glitch 99, Team Battle or Secret League. |
| `from_time` | text | yes |  |  | The UTC time from which to display events as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM |
| `count` | number | no | 5 |  | How many events to display - must be from 1 to 12 (default 5) |

### `/miniprix`

Show the track selection for the current or next Mini-Prix.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`py/pengbot99/bot.py:465`](../py/pengbot99/bot.py#L465) |
| Usage | `/miniprix <event_type> [track_filter] [utc_time] [verbose]` |
| Checks in code | none |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Everyone |
| Where | #ask-pengbot. Admin and Circuit Crew can also use it in the staff channels they can see, such as #playground, #bot-playground and #host-hub. |
| Reads and writes | The active profile's Mini-Prix managers: public, or private with `Private` in `event_type`. |
| Side effects | Replies in the channel, for everyone to see. |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Choices as you type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `event_type` | text | yes |  | yes | Mini-Prix, Classic Mini-Prix, or the private version of either. |
| `track_filter` | text | no |  | yes | Only show track selections that include this track. |
| `utc_time` | text | no |  |  | The UTC time from which to display events as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM |
| `verbose` | true or false | no | false |  | Set True to display the track selection internal code name. |

## Help

### `/explain`

Explain the Grand Prix rotation, the current schedule, or what's on now and next.

| | |
|---|---|
| Handler | [`py/pengbot99/bot.py:723`](../py/pengbot99/bot.py#L723) |
| Usage | `/explain <topic>` |
| Checks in code | none |
| Who (Discord Integrations) | Everyone |
| Where | #ask-pengbot. Admin and Circuit Crew can also use it in the staff channels they can see, such as #playground, #bot-playground and #host-hub. |
| Reads and writes | `explain_cmd.Explainer`: the active slot 2 schedule, and `EVENT_SCHEDULE_FILE` for the profile switches to come. |
| Side effects | Replies in the channel, for everyone to see. |

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Choices as you type | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `topic` | text | yes |  | yes | Grand Prix Rotation, Current Schedule, or Current And Upcoming Events. |
